title: A Class Looks Back: Our First Month · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Last month, our beginner English class had a problem. The classroom was small. There were only eight chairs, but there were twelve students. We were not happy. Our teacher, Ms. Li, was very kind. She said, "I am sorry. The big room was closed last week because of a water problem." We were sad, but we listened. Ms. Li said, "Next week, we are going to use the library room. It is big and quiet."
prompt:
Was your classroom big or small last year?
Were you happy in your English class?
What are you going to do after class today?
Why are you learning English?
